review_description: Tindo has provided excellent customer service. They have kept us informed about where everything is up to. The salesperson was thorough and detailed in his advice to us and provided all the information we wanted during the quoting process. He’s also been easily available afterwards to respond to our queries. Installation was great, and the panels and inverter are working as expected so far. (We’ve only had them for 1 week.)  The installers were punctual, neat, polite and thorough in the installation and set up of the system, and in their explanations and responses to our questions. They did a great job. We haven’t yet had the ordered battery installed because there is a backlog. Hopefully that will happen soon. We’ve been impressed and happy with the process and products so far. While the price was a bit higher than other quotes, we were willing to pay it because of the quality of the system and the locally made solar panels.

We found the whole process quite smooth. The first contact was with a sales engineer who understood the system and was able to answer the slightly technical questions.Several other companies used call centres, obviously overseas, who only wanted to arrange on-site inspections. That may be fine, but in my opinion those types of installers favour slight sales pressure over a quality discussion.Kevin at Tindo Solar engaged in a good discussion of our needs and circumstances, provided options and answered our concerns.We feel very comfortable we have made the right choice.

Overall experience has been good. We installed a 6.8kw system and it is producing 63% of our consumption whilst putting 57% of our production back to the grid. System is battery ready and upgradable so waiting to see our next bill and for batteries to get more affordable. Hopefully our bills are at least half ?

Great sales team, provided lots of information, answered all of my questions and adapted the system to suit our needs. They aren't cheap but the quality and service was excellent. I also liked to buy from a company that makes solar panels here in Australia.

Unfortunately, we were caught out by a installer who went into liquidation after the quote. Tindo stepped up reassuring us they were reputable, reliable and nothing like the previous company. The install was booked for July, then deferred, re-booked twice more and after waiting a few more months of being told firm dates were locked in the install was done in November.Approximately 4 months after the installation we had rain water leaking through the ceiling directly above where the panels are located, so we contacted Tindo seeking assitance to resolve. Six, now seven months after the install no one has contacted us about it to inspect the damage and the poor lady in customer service has tried her best but no one has repsonded or called. Still not one call from a Service Manager to acknowledge to leak and subsequent damage caused by it or any attempt resolve it.And to top it off, the system has still not been commissioned 7 months after the installation, so we do not have a supply agreement in place either!!! Which means we are unable to even compare the viability or performance of the systemNo wonder the Solar industry reputation is in the gutter. They take the Goverment subsidy and leave you holding the can.

Sales quoting process was impeccable.Lionel is a credit to the Tindo business.He answered all of our questions (and I bugged him for weeks with additional questions), educated us on a few points, and let us in on an unadvertised CommBank GreenLoan deal which gave us the ability to go bigger without breaking the budget.Install was floorless.  All trades did their jobs well and cleaned up so you wouldn’t have even known they were there.All panels, hardware and a Telsa car Charger all installed, configured and demo’d by lunchtime.They did EVERYTHING for us.You definitely get what you pay for!The SolarEdge monitoring app has been monitored and helped us change our usage habits to the point were we’re now using over 70% of our power from solar, and exporting a pile back to the grid.It’ll be time for a SolarEdge battery as soon as the budget allows to harness this excess.The Tindo panels are great and always buy Aussie made first if you can.

Everything was fine, they are not the cheapest, but if you want quality products (solar panels built in SA for Australian conditions) and an organisation that will be here tomorrow,  I would definetly recommend.Watch out for their finance departamant sending unsolicited emails after you have paid the deposit almost demanding you pay the balance prior to install. That is not how it works, especially when the sales contract days 'Cash on Delivery', not 'Delivery on Cash' as their finance departamant would lead you to believe. Happy to recommend otherwise.
Every aspect of dealing with Tindo was first class in my obviously one off experience.

Unfortunately the installation compromised my roof resulting in a slow leak to a spare bathroom. This caused massive mould that insurers refused to cover because I should have seen it earlier - I don't use that room! Tindo indicated that they would send someone out to fix the installation but that has not happened.

Lionel was very helpful in laying out the options and how the system would work and supplied a quote promptly.The installation occurred on schedule and the crew were polite and tidied up well.All of the connections and liaison with AGL went smoothly.Our only concern was that their finance department wanted payment in advance for the installation, which we refused because it was not normal business practice with any other trades we had dealt with. When we said we would go elsewhere if they insisted, one of the directors rang us the same day and waived the requirement.

Right from the get go Tindo presented options for my needs with a friendly open and professional manner. The quote came back in a timely fashion and any further queries I had were answered, many thanks to Lionel my Tindo rep.The install was was done by Luke who was very tidy with the fit out, I even asked him if he did private work lol.

5 years ago Tindo installed solar panels on our two level house.We wanted to support a company which manufactured   panels in  Australia   for our conditions.The service was exceptional .    The  process of finding the appropriate panels was well discussed, installation was smooth and follow up service as very good.When we wanted to add more panels and a storage battery  there was no hesitation in  contacting Tindo.The Tindo representative was more than helpful and spent considerable time to ensure that we were fully informed of our options. He returned on several occasions to answer our questions and to confirm  that   the product offered would meet our needs.I would have no hesitation in recommending  Tindo.

Tindo stuffed me around when I installed my first 10kw system but now I want to put another 10kw on the house they took the order and I organised a first week in September install and was told all would be good but they just left it and I’ve called them twice now to be told they can’t get the parts so they didn’t call to update me they just left it so I have cancelled and I’ll go elsewhere very poor service…customer service very poor.

Tindo was ok Electricity supplier took about 6 weeks to put in new smart meter then we found out they installed it wrong after that inverter stoped working still waiting for this to be fixed . from April to July it may have been working for about 2 weeks. NOT REAL HAPPY
Tindo are great. The whole process went well and they were happy to answer all my questions. I am now reaping the benefits of a quality system made in Australia for Australian conditions.

We purchased the home we had been renting for 4 years. As soon as we settled we contacted Tindo Solar as they are in Adelaide. From the first moment we dealt with them They were excellent. We went sure until we toured their factory (recommend you all do it). From the time we signed the purchase agreement we knew what was happening and when.  The only thing different was the installers were 2 days early.The installers were fantastic to deal with. Polite friendly and answered any questions we had. We did have a couple of issues but those were Origin Energy's faults. The team at Tindo helped us work through those and even after have been keen to advice when needed. We purchased a battery as well which has been great. Comes with an app so you can see what the battery and system are doing.

Tindo people provided excellent service from the initial enquiry. We were kept informed regarding progress of the installation at every stage and all aspects of the installation were completed in the timeframe promised, including organisation with our energy provider of the changeover to a smart meter. The person doing the installation was punctual and explained what to expect when the system was connected. In the short instance to check all was working properly, it was awesome to see the meter spinning backwards!We chose to go with a 6.6kw system with microinverters with roof panels facing north, east and west and while it cost a bit more than a quote for an optimised system, we wanted to support a local company with a great track record manufacturing panels locally, with back up close by if needed. The system is working really well and producing heaps of solar!
Sale quoting process goodInstallation Very goodCustomer service good

We have an existing 12 panel array (Sharp panels) making up 2.2kW with a Fronius IG20 inverter rated at 1.8kW.We wanted to expand our setup and potentially add a battery, with a view of moving to an electric vehicle in the next 12-18 months. We have recently changed our water heater over to a Sanden heat pump (was on-demand gas) so now we are a fully electric-only house.Tindo offered the following upgrade:22 x Tindo Karra-330 DC Solaredge Optimised Solar Panel1 x SolarEdge Storedge SE5000-AUS Grid Connect Inverter12-year Inverter and 25-year Solar Panel Warranties1 x LG Chem RESU 10HV Battery1 x Solaredge Electricity Meter Kit 1PH MonitorTiled Roof Array FrameSystem Power 7.26 kWNumber of Modules 22Number of Inverters 1Number of Phases 1The sales and quoting process was pretty straight-forward, The Tindo sales rep was switched on to what we were wanting, and the system offered looked like it would suit our current and future needs. The Solaredge inverter can have an integrated EV charging cable added in future if we need. This is a neat solution.The installation went well, the guys were in threat of being rained out, but the weather held off to complete most of the work. We still need to have a supply cut-off switch and a new meter put in place. We have some asbestos in our old meter box which is holding up the works, this needs to be removed (SAPN work?) before the final work can be done.Other than that, we have our battery working in the evenings and plenty of extra electricity being generated by the new system. The detailed monitoring has not been set up yet, but from our own observations of the import/export meter and the inverter/battery status, we are pretty well self-sufficient on solar, with plenty going back into the grid in the middle of the day.

Tindo is a South Australian company that we chose to support for its solar panels that are made right here in Adelaide- designed purposely for Australian conditions. They provide excellent service to boot, and we had no hesitation after 12 months to get a battery installed as well

Installation on time as booked. Excellent crew. Can't say yet how the Tindo panels will go as not yet connected to the network. Went with them as a SA company, & hoping they are top end quality. Expensive, so will see. We have added more solar to ensure our family is energy neutral or even better, positive. With trees planted on my property, I've taken care of the energy usage of at least 4 families.

Very knowledgeable, polite and tidy.  Good follow up.  Sales and quoting good.  Very patient with our questions.  Allowed us to tour factory.  I recommend your service as a good way to prepare and gain knowledge about solar.

From initial inquiry, sales presentation, design of system, installation and follow-up, Tindo Solar delivered quality at every stage.  Despite some delay for installation due to sickness of an installer, the company made every effort to complete our order as quickly as possible, which was well communicated and executed.  The pricing of the system was reasonable and competitive considering its level of quality. The grid connection was handled smoothly and efficiently, coincident with the installation and so no delay in the system beginning operation. The system has performed exceptionally since its operation and one minor concern was immediately addressed by the installer.  I highly recommend this company and its product.  Could not be more satisfied!

I went with Tindo, due to the Aussie build of the panels. I am extremely pleased with the customer service I have received from every person from Tindo so far, from Jamsie, who organised the quote (even with my chop and changing :), to the service I received from Casey post install. The install went smoothly, and the battery and solar are working perfectly for our usage and needs. The electricians that installed everything did an extremely neat job, and were friendly and keen to answer any questions I had. We even ran into an issue with how the electricity was originally installed at our property, which caused some complications and stress, and Tindo took full ownership and continued to support us until we were good to go. Overall a very professional and supportive operation. Well done Tindo.

I contacted Tindo Solar for a quote. Their representative was helpful and prompt in getting details on the install. They organised everything. The installer turned up when they said they would and went about the installation that was completed same day with no issues. The system works well and generates plenty of power. They're certainly not the cheapest out there but they're SA made and I'm happy to pay a bit extra for that, rather than deal with overseas call centres and unknown installers.
Everything was smooth and without issue. The system was installed and running in one day. Sales rep didn't try to oversell us as some others did and listened to what we wanted whilst giving advice.

We had a wonderful experience with Tindo Solar from start to finish. Our sales/Customer Service Rep Jamie was extremely knowledgeable and explained everything to us in a way we understood everything. Jamie has a personalized and genuine level of customer experience and we truly appreciated his time and effort. We are extremely happy with the system, not only our Panels Australian Made right here is SA, they are delivering on our expectations. We received our first bill after our new system was installed a few months back and we have a HUGE credit on our bill which we have never experienced before. We use to receive $1200 a quarter bills so to be in credit now is an unbelievable feeling and a true investment. Ivan who installed our system was so helpful, knowledgeable and professional. We highly recommend having a Tindo Solar system installed, you wont look back! Grateful to the whole team at Tindo. Thank you!

The product was well explained by the company salesman.  Its pricing was reasonable and the quality is excellent.  The installation was done professionally and its performance since has been as promised.  I highly recommend this company and product, especially as locally manufactured in Adelaide.

I found the sales and quoting process upfront and ran very smoothly.The installation ran smoothly. Everyone of the installers were polite, tidy and punctual.Customer service was excellent and very helpful through the whole process.
Customer service was excellent and the change of meter/grid connection went to plan
Everything went smoothly the installation was fast and all my enquiries have been answered.
Sales process was very informative and helpfulQuick and professional installation.  Installer was very helpful knowledgeable and friendly.Grid connection switched on at installation and works well.
I found Tindo helpful and professional from beginning to the end. Everything was handled on-time and without fuss.

The quoting process was fabulous. Salesperson proposed and explained the system in detail. Was absolutely pleased with the proposed system though not cheap. Wished the Solaredge inverter proposed and installed was a HD series one instead of the older SE series. Installation went well but they left a cut wire sticking out on the roof and caused a leak when rain came. Called customer service about it and problem was quickly attended to, though there is a water mark on the roof.Happy system is live now, and generating energy and saving me money. Customer service is OK (great if issue is urgent, like the roof leakage) but can be better, in particular, addressing questions that were put to them. Frustrated of not answering my questions, I decided to Google for answers and found them. Hopefully, service will be better in the future.
Happy with the whole process overall. Good explanation on the system & how it all operates for my particular home.  All shown to me on  computer,( which I wouldn't otherwise understand!

System quote and installation was done very quickly - 18 days from quote to job completion. Everyone we dealt with fromTindo were professional and helpful from the very knowlegeable sales person through to the admin staff. We also received regular updates during the 18 day wait period.The installation crew were punctual, courteous and efficient, and also left their work area clean and tidy. Because we already had a smart meter the system was connected to the grid at the time of installation. The information we received regarding how well we could expect the system to work on cloudy days was correct - in fact it works even better than expected.

Very friendly, clear and easy to get your head around what we where purchasing.Clean, tidy, very polite.Grid connection was done on the day of install. All sorted out by Tindo. Constantly kept in the loop.

Due to issues with shading I went for a top quality system that would degrade as little as possible over time. Tindo were honest with their data from the Desert Knowledge Centre so although I paid a bit more I'm satisfied that I will have a reliable system for many years to come.

Installation was a breeze the guys, very friendly and were on time and didn't leave any rubbish laying around. Matthew the sales person I spoke to couldn't have been more helpful. All in all its a 20 out of 10 for Tindo solar a very peasant experience.

Quote was done at home well within a week of first contact, information was immediate and recommendations have proven to be precisely as stated.Installer came prior to the scheduled date to ensure existing wiring was appropriate to the system.The installation was completed as scheduled and the site was clean and tidy when the job was complete.Following installation I had to wait three weeks for the energy retailer to install a smart meter (I had been told of this at the time of quote) and following this found that the solar monitoring software was showing error messages. Tindo arranged rectification within 2 working days and made follow up calls to ensure that the system was reporting correctly
Installation excellent, customer service from Tondo not real good. After a hiccup with the pricing,due to computer hitch,no after sales backup or is all ok now?
My system was installed within 3 weeks, including the monitoring app.

Tindo quoting process very helpful. Information about the product was comprehensive. Can see on-line how they are made or visit the factory. No problems with installation. Attended when they said they would. Everything went smoothly. They requested full payment before it was up and running which I didn't agree with so I told them I was holding a small % back till it was up and running and they were okay with that. Excellent easy to understand Solar Analytics who are also very helpful if you have questions. Researching Solar Quotes was extremely helpful in the lead up to my decision making.

As a retired Engineer I undertook a lot of investigative reading before hand to ensure that I could ask the correct questions and assess the value of the PV panels on offer.  I had  decided that my selection would be based upon monocrystalline PV cells with Micro Inverters that would permit future expansion of the system and the latter inclusion of storage batteries when they became more cost effective and would permit auto change over to storage should mains supply fail.  I then reviewed the quality of panels and roof supporting attachments as a unique system with regards to structural strength, longevity of components, warranty and service levels.  From this I identified a limited number of preferred suppliers and used the opportunity to then observe systems being installed so I could directly compare quality and installation of systems. My final selection reduced to two possibilities who were very close but once I adjusted for supporting local / Australian manufacture Tindo was selected.  The installation was of the highest quality and they even had the patience to put up with me hovering around them asking questions and closely observing what they were doing, even the wife was impressed with their professionalism and work ethic.  The system has now been working for some 6 months with an excellent online monitoring from MyEnlighten the Enphase micro inverter manufacture.  Each panel is identified for output and download into a spreadsheet.  A clear day produces 82% overall efficiency which the expected result.  I am very pleased with the total process which will pay for itself within the next 3 years.

During the Quote process everything was explained clearly. Taken a tour through the factory where the panels are made and assembled very informative tour. This took place before signing contract. A few extras which I knew nothing about were explained and I agreed to adding to quote. Price is higher than those seen on  TV but I'm glad I paid the extra and got my panels from Tindo. Australian made and local company, After Sale service is faultless they monitor panel performance and contact you if panel performance drops. Tindo keep in contact with purchasers. To be honest the best $$$$ i have spent. When you buy Tindo panels you also get great caring after sales service. IF you want a Top Quality Product go to Tindo. When fitted workers were very polite, answered any questions, very tidy looking installation, and all packaging was removed. Installed all 18 panels by lunch time.

Tindo did not try to over sell their product. They gave me the facts and tried to be as competitive as possible with their price, and managed to come within a few hundred of the cheaper competitors, but with better warranty and quality. I have had my panels since January 2019 and love my panels, I  have had great service from Tindo in the time I have had them.

It is so refreshing to communicate with a company that is local, supports Australian workers, assembles the panels locally, uses a good team of installers and provides friendly and helpful after sales service and guarantees their product for decades.  If anything goes wrong with my new solar system, I feel I am in good hands for a satisfactory resolution.

First account was in credit. Winter will be the real test. We would not hesitate to recommend Tindo Solar to any prospective buyer. We have been impressed with after sales follow up and we are also impressed with the monitoring system which informs us of the equipmentâ€™s performance.
The sales representative and the solar installer both arrive at promised quote / installation times and were very professional in their presentation.
Installers were fantastic, turned on on same day as installation
After sales service has been very good
Very happy with the way installation occurred. All went smoothly with SA Power Networks arriving on the same day so the whole process was seamless.

I was most impressed with all the people who came here and explained there services and gave us a quote. We just had the impression that Tindo although dearer would be easier to deal with being an all local company
My wife and I would like to say how impressed we were by the professionalism of the salesman, the team at Tindo and the installers.Thank you.
Why don't you return my phone calls!!!!!!!!!!

The best thing we ever purchased our electricity bill went from $600+ down to $180 per quarter if you haven't  got the best solar panels from Tindo solar your flaming mad South Australian owned at Mawson Lakes from start to finish the whole experience was fantastic every one involved from the salesman Daryl to Jarrod in the office the guys who installed the system all professional on time every thing left  neat and tidy if you  don't get a Tindo solar system
Installer did not know how to connect it to the internet

System works perfectly, installation was smooth and the sales team was super nice and caring.After sales experience was great with the monitoring system and the customer service guys making sure i was happy with the product.

I am absolutely disgusted with the after sales service from Tindo. We have a big system which is underperforming. Over half a dozen microinverters have failed, which they refuse to replace unless we pay for the electrician to do so. No monitoring system now as enecsys went into administration. Save yourself money & heartache & go with a different company. We bought our system in the first year they were open, to support the aussie market. Big mistake. Absolute garbage, esp when I'm still getting electricity bills over $1000. Taking it to consumer affairs.

I bought from Tindo because it is a south Australian company and had heard it's service was very good. This has proved to be the case  I am very happy with the system so far and intend to extend it to a battery.

From our first visit to Tindo Solar, throughout the purchase and installation, plus follow up communications with Tindo we have had nothing but first rate experiences with them.  We are very happy with the performance of our solar system which was purchased in June, and would very definitely recommend both their product and their personnel.  We really appreciated the service we have received, and the fact that Tindo follow up to make sure everything is continuing to work as expected is another plus for them.
They were very helpful and quick on getting the job done

Tindo have been fantastic from start to finish. People need to look at the 'whole' picture when buying a system & research the price against:1. Quality (of system & customer service)2. Longevity of system3. Performance (investigate this! Tindo OUT PERFORMS other products. The others use an advertising budget so people are familiar with the name)4. Guarantee (how long will they stand behind their product?)5. Future/Deals (Tindo offers GREAT deals, plus I can add to my system eg Battery/extra panels without any hassle)6. Monitoring ServiceNot only am I getting the BEST possible product/service for my money, I am supporting Australian made & can go to the factory to talk with the people!

I actually thought Tindo was one of your 3 quotes....Very happy with the 5kw premium system with lifetime solar analytics subscription. There were cheaper systems but I am very confident in Tindo's quality. Also I found your website very useful to cut through the minefield of information so thanks Finn and thanks Vince and the Tindo team.

From the get go the sales person explained everything to me. We then needed to modify placement on roof which wasn't an issue at all.The installers were fantastic and did a professional job in a timely manner. A local SA company producing quality solar panels for Australian conditions, what more could you ask for. Would not hesitate on recommending Tindo Solar to anyone contemplating the installation of a solar system.

Hi Finn; I'm unable to comment on the system as it's not going to be installed until later this month.I opted for the Tindo 275W panels (20 of) which should give us 5.5kW. Chose them because as you know, they're made in SA, and I didn't reckon a tier 1 panel made overseas would be any better.

Best investment we have ever made.Tindo have been absolutely fantastic to deal with right from the beginning of our enquiry.Excellent service provided by everyone including the installers.Excellent customer service as we as follow up calls.Thank you to each and everyone at Tindo Solar.
I would not hesitate to use tindo solar again and recommended them to my son who also had them install a system and is just as happy.
I love the fact that Tindo is a local manufacturer of solar panels with performance geared to our climate.

I spent a lot of time checking out solar on the roof, would I get my money back would its de worthwhile,I asked the salesperson a lot of. questions and received honest answers, I an now very happy about the decision I made to have them installed and yes they are so far paying for themselves, I chose tindo Solar for quality and an Australian built and serviced here by Australians.

We went with Tindo Solar. We also got quotes outside the ones you referred. We went with Tindo as they assemble their panels here in SA and are owned by a long term business Cool or Cosy. Also supporting SA and 80 kms away if anything goes wrong. We bought 2 systems being 3.32kW for our home and our rental. One has been switched on and the performance so far is producing excellent results. The panels on roofs are near to north and start producing @ 8am to 7pm on a clear day at 26 degrees on the 8/11/17. Max production has been 24.5. This is way above prediction for November. Roof is prime direction.Panels are Karra 275 with x1 Solax inverter with extended warranty. Systems were a little dearer and installation was a smooth process. All other quotes were good but Cool or Cosy have the longest business years.

Tindo Solar have been exemplary in providing warranty support of our solar system, in particular replacing faulty SolarBridge micro-inverters. In addition, when SunPower unexpectedly and disappointingly shut down the SolarBridge Power Portal in March 2018 preventing online monitoring of panel performance, Tindo Solar provided outstanding support with a solution; specifically installing a Solar Analytics module which allows both online monitoring of panel performance and real-time power consumption on multiple circuits. Overall I have no hesitation in recommending Tindo Solar for the high quality of their locally manufactured solar panels and their responsive customer support.

Two of the suppliers you suggested contacted me but only one actually sent a quote.  There was no follow up when I didn't contact them after the quote.  They really didn't seem interested in my business.

The system was installed less than two weeks from the quote and they also organize the meter from SA Power Networks which was installed less than two weeks later. Very happy with the system as it actually can generate higher than specified size.
After 6 months we have managed to reduce our bill by 2/3. I see that as a good result. I have not given 5 stars as it's early days yet.

Im giving an update On our 3.32kw tindo solar installed back in Nov 2017.It has now been 5mths since installation. This system is performing extremely well. 1st quarter bill consisted of 50 days without solar and 42 days with solar.  Bill total was $127.00 on 8th jan 2018. Just received our second bill 10th April and we are in credit even though the energy price increase and we also have ordinary storage electric hot water which we are charged that energy for heating through the night.Performance is outstanding.Had a grid issue back in early March where the inverter was shutting down for short time through a few days, but Tindo was quick to sort this out.Having wifi on your inverter shows exactly what is happening during the day so you can relay information to the supplier.Our system consists of 12x Kara 275 panels and a Solax tx inverter = 3.32kw. Best itâ€™s produced for a day is 24.2kw.Our ave consumption is now 5.6 kw a day compaired to 15.51 kw this time last year.I hope this information helps someone that is unsure about getting solar.

In all our dealings with Tindo Solar, we have experienced courtesy from every person we have spoken to. When we thought we had a problem, it was solved efficiently and promptly. There wasn't a problem with the equipment, the problem was with S.A. Power Networks, who without telling anyone, used a bypass on a sub station while they worked on the sub station, without a regulator on the bypass and this caused very high voltages to come down the line. Our system was delivered within the time frame quoted and for the price that was quoted. Tindo Solar is a South Australian Company , this was another reason why we chose Tindo, because it was local and Australian. We  have now experienced their excellent after sales service and appreciated being able to ring the Company and speak to a real person and not a computer. Keep up the good work Tindo.
Having the battery with the Solar PV has made all the difference. The battery discharges every evening and charges up pretty quickly when the Solar is delivering

It was a good experience; everything was explained, quality fit out and most to the applications to install the system was done. The installers were very professional and organised, they also cleaned up the site after the install.
Happy with  Tindo installation although the sales staff need a bit of polishing up. We have also informed them of the same

Install was good, sales person was the best but terrible after sales and communication, and tindo also donâ€™t honour their word by paying out the referral fee for any person they are recommended to them, so wonâ€™t be doing that anymore.

Terrible after sales service. 18 months after purchase the micro inverters started to fail. Iâ€™ve been running at 30% specâ€™d capacity for over six months now with no repair in sight. A $16k system that I can honestly say is rubbish value for money.

I purchased 20 panels in 2013 with the Sunpower power manager. That power manager failed and was replaced in Dec15. Then  it stopped communicating and I discovered only later that 18 of my 20 panels were working. Tindo replaced these inverters. They say they replaced all 20 but I have no way of verifying this. Then they said I had to pay for a new power manager because the old power manager would not work with the new inverters. They tries to charge me $550 for this. I offered 1/2 in early Oct 17 and the new inverters were installed at the end of Oct 17. They refused my offer and have been robo texting me (35 to date) chasing payment. I spoke to Consumer affairs and they advised not to pay. Now I have Tindo (Robert) threatening to disconnect the power manager and they claim that they don't know if this will impact on the panels and their generation. Amazingly bad public relations in my view and seems to be consistent with other comments. If you are paying more than other suppliers to assist a local SA company then you would expect better.

We have had our system for approx 4 years and have had NUMEROUS micro inverter failures. Now all of my micro inverters will be replaced by another brand on the 9th Feb. I'm now expected to pay for the monitoring system($550) which according to Tindo is a great deal. According to me not so good!! Why should I have to pay anything considering their system has failed.. I will be contacting consumer affairs. I'm sure I'm not the only one this has happened to so please comment if you have any feedback from consumer affairs.
Very willing to answer all my questions and requests. They ticked a lot of boxes from your checklist.

As the system has been in for less than a month, it is too soon to form an opinion on the performance as yet, we'll have to wait until the next account from our electricity retailerAlso, you should be aware of the Trustpilot  review which I sent on or about the 10th of March, re my experience with your crew, the receipt of which was acknowledged by Johnathan
Tindo did an amazing job, they were very helpful and professional, and I felt very comfortable with them from the beginning. They took the time to understand my needs and gave me very sound advice.

Location is Ballarat Victoria. System installed over 2 days consisting of -  18 Tindo 275 panels with 18 Enphase micro-inverters. Mostly exceeding estimated average generation of 17.77 kWh/day (more than 30 kWh/day with little cloud) during first week. Awaiting supply and installation of Tesla Powerwall 2 (still months away) but apparent through Enphase Envoy Enlighten monitoring supplied, that we will be mostly self-sufficient eventually.  Most of the PV generation is being exported to the grid - with appliances now using mostly solar power during the day.

Since installation I have had numerous inverter failures and the service to replace/ repair the failed items is terrible. And the customer relations is non existent.
